product.Product Description: Diablo's 1/2" x 18" detail file sanding belts include break-through innovations that improve performance, extend sanding life, and increase productivity. Featuring a premium aluminum oxide blend, these belts remove material faster than other sanding belts and offer an extra-long sanding life. The stearate coating reduces build-up while the premium joint connection ensures the belt can withstand a variety of sanding applications such as heavy stock removal, planing and sanding. Clog-SHIELD™, Diablo's own blend of grinding agents, reduces loading while the superior grain bonding system, ENDURA-BOND™, delivers longer life and extreme durability.
product.Product Title: 1/2" x 18" Detail File Sanding Belt Assorted Pack (6-pc)
product.Ideal For: Surface leveling and heavy stock removal; moderate stock removal; and final sanding
product.Product Features: Assorted Pack includes: (2) 50-Grit/Coarse grit sanding belts for surface leveling and heavy stock/paint removal, (2) 80-Grit/Medium grit sanding belts for moderate stock removal, and (2) 120-Grit/Fine grit sanding belts for final sanding; Premium aluminum oxide blend for fast material removal and extra-long sanding life; Stearate coating reduces pitch build-up or loading of the belt; Premium joint connection creates a strong bond, keeping the belt intact while sanding an array of applications; Clog-SHIELD™ reduces pitch build-up and clogging; ENDURA-BOND provides superior grit-to-backing bond for extreme durability
